name: Hero-God's Rage
description: Sophreista's ghost glows red, and shrieking in fury, she flies at her opponents.
disable: DC 18 Athletics (trained) to subdue the spirit, DC 18 Religion to calm the spirit, DC 16 Deception or DC 16 Diplomacy to talk the spirit down; two total successes are required to disable the haunt
routine: (1 action) Sophreista lashes out at the nearest living creature, dealing (1d10+6) Bludgeoning Damage damage (Basic DC 20 Reflex Saving Throw save) and binding their fate to hers; a creature that critically fails their save is Doomed 1 (maximum Doomed 3).

offensiveAbilities.name: Cry Havoc
offensiveAbilities.description:
Trigger The performance concludes with fewer than 8 Pathos Points

Effect Sophreista screams in rage; all living creatures in the area must succeed at a DC 20 Will Saving Throw save or be Frightened 1 (Frightened 2 on a critical failure).
